name: scansafe-evacuee-android
description: Android wrapper for the ScanSafe evacuee app.

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && npm run android:assets && node scripts/build-debug-apk.mjs
